{{Quote|The planet of Gala has been ruled for many years by the Beju-Tallah dynasty. They were successful in uniting a world with deep tribal hatreds.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="The Hidden Past" />}}
